products.name: OpenCash
products.title: OpenCash: a cashier app for small shops in Indonesia, by Mido
products.description: The Flutter app of Kasir Opencash, a point-of-sale system for small businesses in Indonesia, built by Mido as a freelancer.
products.h1: OpenCash, a cashier app for small shops
products.lead: The Flutter app of Kasir Opencash, a point-of-sale system for small businesses in Indonesia: sales, stock, returns, petty cash and Bluetooth receipts. I build it as a freelancer.
products.overview: Cashiers open a shift, scan or search products, take cash or non-cash payments and print the receipt. Owners read sales, profit and stock from the same data.
features: Variants, units, bundles, discounts and fractional quantities.
Park an order and pick it up later in the cart.
Returns by expiry date, petty cash with a photo as proof.
Sales, profit and loss, items sold, refunds and settlement.
products.cover_alt: A cashier at a shop counter beside the OpenCash sales dashboard
shots: OpenCash sales dashboard with a seven-day stock chart
OpenCash product list with prices and stock
products.build_h: How I build the OpenCash app
products.build: I have built the mobile app alone since the first commit in August 2026: more than 330 commits, Riverpod for state, Dio for the API and over a hundred tests. The owner's web back office opens inside the app.
build_rows: Cart and scanner share one path, counted in a base unit.
An idempotency key on every request and a queue for token refresh.
The back office prints to the Bluetooth printer through a native bridge.
Pending non-cash payments are settled when a shift closes.
One make command bumps the build and builds the bundle for Google Play.
products.hero_alt: OpenCash sales dashboard and product list on two phones
products.build_alt: OpenCash on a tablet, uploading many products at once

products.name: Journey
products.title: Journey: the office and events platform of Werkudara Group, by Mido
products.description: Journey is one Next.js platform for Werkudara Group's event guests and team apps, built by Mido in the CoE team with AI agents.
products.h1: Journey, an office platform at Werkudara
products.lead: One platform that took manual work online for many departments at Werkudara. I build it alone, with AI agents.
products.overview: Journey started as event pages for guests and grew into the home of the team's own apps. Guests reach their event through a personal link; staff sign in once for every app.
features: Gala dinners, seminars, trips, handbooks and guides, with RSVP and check-in.
Agenda, QR or face check-in, minutes and a live quiz.
Clock in with a selfie and the office location; leave and a team calendar.
Wellbeing points, a leaderboard and rewards, with Strava.
Room booking, signage and Friday Sharing
Meeting rooms, the office TVs and open CSR donations.
products.cover_alt: The Journey home with its five apps: WAM 2026, WLM, Signage, WG People and Journey Admin
shots: The Journey home on a phone
The office guide on a phone
The office guide's welcome and route map
products.build_h: How I build the Journey platform
products.build: I am the only developer on it, as IT Specialist for AI enablement and automation in Werkudara Group's Center of Excellence team. I take each module from a plan and a mockup to a prototype, then build, ship and look after it, working with AI coding agents. Journey replaced one-off event microsites and an old wellbeing app.
build_rows: Postgres with row-level security, deployed on Vercel.
MediaPipe and ONNX Runtime match faces on the device.
Access set per app and per event.
Galleries on Cloudflare R2, web push notifications.
products.hero_alt: The Journey home and the office guide on two phones
products.build_alt: Your Visit to Werkudara, the guide to finding the office

products.name: Torcons
products.title: Torcons: an AI chat app for iOS and Android, by Mido
products.description: Torcons: AI chat with live streaming, three sign-in options and voice, built in Flutter for iOS and Android.
products.h1: Torcons, an AI chat app for iOS and Android
products.lead: AI chat that streams its answers, sign-in with Google, Apple or Meta, and voice in and out, for iOS and Android.
products.overview: Torcons is a chat app for AI models, built from design mockups and the Open WebUI web app. It later grew a notes app, Torcons Note, on the same modules.
features: Answers appear while they are being written.
Sign-in with Google, Apple or Meta
Threads kept in as many folders as needed.
Speech to text and text to speech
A notes app in the style of Notion, on the same modules.
products.cover_alt: Torcons searching the web and keeping threads in folders
shots: Torcons turning a prompt into a picture of a cat
Torcons listing five tourist spots in Indonesia
Torcons project folders in the sidebar
Torcons listening through speech to text
products.build_h: How I built the Torcons app
products.build: I built the mobile side from the designs to the store listings, with Riverpod for state across workspaces and threads, and a Melos monorepo so the chat and notes apps share their code.
build_rows: SidebarItemModel and ItemSideBar draw the navigation.
Reactive state for workspaces and threads.
Speech plays while the answer still streams.
Shared modules for Torcons and Torcons Note.
Builds for Google Play and the App Store.
products.hero_alt: Torcons forecasting gold prices and drawing a picture
products.build_alt: Torcons listening through speech to text

products.name: AI Care
products.title: AI Care: a telemedicine app with AI symptom checks, by Mido
products.description: The symptom-check engine and Xendit payments of AI Care, a telemedicine app with 5K+ installs and a 4.6 rating.
products.h1: AI Care, AI symptom checks and doctor chat
products.lead: I built the symptom checks and the Xendit payments of a health app with 5K+ installs and a 4.6 rating on Google Play.
products.overview_h: What the AI Care app does
products.overview: AI Care helps people check their symptoms, then talk to a doctor: self-diagnosis, health updates and paid consultations in one app.
features: Questions that narrow down what the symptoms may mean.
Videos and articles in the app.
products.cover_alt: AI Care screens laid out on a teal ground
products.screens_h: AI Care screens on Google Play
shots: AI Care home with symptom check and doctor consultation
AI Care self check for eye symptoms
AI Care health education videos and articles
AI Care chat with a doctor
products.build_h: How I built the AI Care features
products.build: I worked on two feature areas: the diagnosis engine, first an expert system and later direct AI analysis, and the payment flow with Xendit. I also added push notifications and speech to text.
build_rows: Symptom rules first, later replaced by AI analysis.
Health data handled under the privacy rules.

products.name: Tjar
products.title: Tjar: a marketplace app for Saudi Arabia, by Mido
products.description: Customer and merchant apps in Arabic for Tjar, built with a remote team in Saudi Arabia.
products.h1: Tjar, a marketplace app for Saudi Arabia
products.lead: Customer and merchant apps in Arabic and English, built with a remote team at Tajar Al-Mestakbel in Saudi Arabia. 1K+ installs on Google Play.
products.overview: Tjar is a marketplace for the Saudi market, with one app for customers and one for merchants.
features: One for shoppers, one for the stores that sell.
Sales for the day and the week at a glance.
Card, Apple Pay and pay-later options, tracked per transaction.
products.cover_alt: Tjar notifications, products and cash transactions
shots: Tjar merchant dashboard with weekly sales
Tjar store figures and payment methods
products.build_h: How I built the Tjar apps
products.build: I refactored the app architecture so the team could keep shipping, then added Arabic right-to-left layouts, analytics, order management and live order tracking, and prepared the releases for both stores.
build_rows: Every layout mirrored for right-to-left reading.
Orders from new to delivered, with instant alerts.
Customers follow each order as it moves.
Reports for merchants inside the app.
products.hero_alt: Tjar merchant dashboard and order list
products.build_alt: Tjar store figures and payment methods

products.name: Badjetin
products.title: Badjetin: a money app for couples, by Mido
products.description: Badjetin is my own money app: spending, budgets, bills, goals and debts, shared by two phones and synced offline.
products.h1: Badjetin, a money app for couples
products.lead: My own app: log spending in seconds and keep budgets, bills, savings goals and debts in one place, online or offline.
products.overview: Badjetin is for people and couples who want one clear view of their money. One account can be used on two phones, and the data syncs between them.
features: An expense, income or transfer in seconds
Or scan a receipt on Android.
What is spent and what is left.
Reminders before each bill is due.
From group to category to each transaction.
products.cover_alt: Badjetin feature graphic: manage your money together
shots: Badjetin home: balance, wallets and budgets
products.build_h: How I built the Badjetin app
products.build: A solo project from idea to Google Play: product and UI design, a warm design system of my own, Flutter with Clean Architecture, an offline database that syncs to Firebase, and a release on every git tag.
build_rows: Domain, infrastructure and presentation, with GetX and flutter_hooks.
Screens read SQLite through drift; changes queue and sync to Firestore.
ML Kit text recognition on the device.
A test that runs two phones against one Firestore.
Release notes from the changelog, an obfuscated build on every tag.
products.build_alt: Badjetin bills, savings goals and debts

products.name: Callink
products.title: Callink: a calling and chat app for teams, by Mido
products.description: Callink: WebRTC calls and team chat, built in React Native, then Flutter, then a native Kotlin module.
products.h1: Callink, a calling and chat app for teams
products.lead: Voice and video calls over WebRTC, built across three generations: React Native, then Flutter, then a native Kotlin module.
products.overview: Callink puts calls, group chat and team channels in one app, and keeps working when the connection drops.
features: A local cache that syncs when back online.
Rings even when the app is closed.
products.cover_alt: Callink chat, call and sign-in screens beside its logo
products.build_h: How I built the Callink app
products.build: I started Callink in React Native, moved it to Flutter, then wrote the call engine as a Kotlin module with Jetpack Compose and VIPER, plus a companion Android app for the incoming-call screen Flutter could not show at the time.
build_rows: React Native, then Flutter, then Kotlin with Jetpack Compose and VIPER.
In Flutter and in native Android.
Local data, synced when the connection returns.
Google Play and the App Store, kept up to date.
products.hero_alt: Callink chat list and a video call
products.build_alt: Callink welcome, security settings and profile

Look up any receipt number and its history.
Pay from a balance kept in the app.

Driver positions pushed to the map.
Delivery zones drawn on Google Maps.
Every step of a delivery kept per receipt.
